name: Ouro Preto (Brazil)
description: Vertical bicolour of black and yellow charged with a grey triangle and the motto PROETIOSUM AURUM NIGRUM in counterchanged letters.
history: Ouro Preto is a historic former capital of Minas Gerais, Brazil, and a World Heritage Site. The motto Pretiosum aurum nigrum, "precious black gold", refers to the dark gold nuggets that gave the town its name in 1698.

features.role: motto PROETIOSUM AURUM NIGRUM in counterchanged letters
